title: set_fx_parameter result
description: What set_fx_parameter returns: the value the parameter actually holds, which is not always the value that was asked for. A plugin clamps a value outside its range rather than rejecting it, so the result reports what landed and flags the difference — telling the producer a threshold was set to -30 dB when the plugin floored it at -24 is the failure this field prevents. The formatted value is what to quote to them, since the raw number is often normalised and means nothing. A mutating tool, so it carries the undo report fields defined by messages/tool-result-undo.schema.json.

fxIndex.description: Chain position of the FX that was changed.

fxName.description: Name of the FX at that chain position.

parameterName.description: Parameter that was set, as REAPER names it.

value.description: The value the parameter holds after the call, read back from the plugin rather than assumed from the input.

previousValue.description: The value the parameter held before the call, so a change can be described as a move rather than a destination.

clamped.description: True when the plugin held the parameter at a bound instead of accepting the requested value. Stated rather than left to be inferred from comparing two numbers, because the agent must not report a value the plugin refused as the value it set.

formattedValue.description: The value as the plugin's own UI displays it — "-6.0 dB", "120 Hz". Present when the plugin supplies one, and the string to say to the producer.

trackReference.description: A track the tool acted on, named as well as identified. The GUID is what the agent addresses the track by on any follow-up call; the name is what it says to the producer, who cannot see a GUID. Returned even when the call supplied a GUID, because a name pattern resolves here rather than in the agent — a safe operation on a confident-but-imperfect match proceeds and this is how it reports which track it chose (Requirement 7.6).

name.description: Track name as shown in REAPER at the time of the call.

guid.description: A stable REAPER GUID, in REAPER's own braced form.

undoPositionBefore.description: REAPER undo stack position captured by the extension immediately before this tool applied its change. A "revert all AI changes" operation calls Undo_DoUndo2 in a loop until the stack is back at this position.

undoDescription.description: Undo point description the extension passed to Undo_EndBlock2 for this tool, persisted with the tool_result message so the chat UI can list what the agent changed.
